rule: TinyCLIP 8M/16 ships unless TinyCLIP 39M/16 is ahead on the kind of eye, as the page would decide it, by a paired difference whose 95% interval lies wholly above zero. The measure is the share right on the wildlife test photos (the extra set's vectors were not published for both models). The comparison is made on the test photos: a choice among two candidates by a rule fixed beforehand, which bends the chosen slot's test figures very little, and which is the one decision here that the test photos took part in.
why: On the share right on the wildlife test photos (the extra set's vectors were not published for both models), TinyCLIP 39M/16 is ahead of TinyCLIP 8M/16 by +4.2 points (+3.3 to +5.2), paired over the same photos. The interval lies above zero, so the larger pocket model ships: a wrong kind gives a person the wrong eyes, and that weighs more than 31 MB downloaded once.
